steps.description: Matrix is 3×3. col0 flag = 1. Pass 1: scan for zeroes, mark headers.
Found zero at (1,1) → mark row header matrix[1][0]=0 and column header matrix[0][1]=0.
Row header matrix[2][0]=1 or col header matrix[0][1]=0 is 0 → zero out (2,1).
Row header matrix[1][0]=0 or col header matrix[0][2]=1 is 0 → zero out (1,2).
